/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re
import urllib.request
url = 'http://localhost:3100/'
html = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
action = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"'"', html).group(1)
boundary = 'catalog-sync-form-boundary'
body = f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{action}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}', 'Origin': 'http://localhost:3100'}, method='POST')
response = urllib.request.urlopen(request)
result = response.read().decode()
print('form submission status:', response.status)
print('redirected to:', response.url)
print('catalog rendered:', 'Product catalog' in result)
print('product rows:', len(re.findall(r'<tr><td>', result)))
PY"
